title: FY2027 ICD-10-CM selected acute-care diagnosis code descriptions
scope: Selected FY2027 U.S. ICD-10-CM billable codes with titles containing common acute-care terms (MI, chest pain, heart failure, arrhythmia, sepsis, pneumonia, respiratory failure, AKI, syncope, stroke, GI hemorrhage, shock, hypoxemia); up to 500 records; full source release ZIP preserved.

limits: Terminology/coding reference only; not a diagnosis, procedure recommendation, care pathway, outcome rate, or patient-level dataset.
Confirm the applicable release and official coding guidelines before any operational coding use.
